html:
SMTO-RST-0026 — This SMTO version can't read the format of your saved data

GUID: 8b5130a7-a56c-52f9-ab64-2311c60cd817
Slug: controller-recovery-format-unsupported
Domain: RST · Subsystem: controller

What happened

  • Your saved data is stored in a format this version of SMTO can't read or convert, for example because a newer version saved it. SMTO stopped without changing the data.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you recently installed an older SMTO or switched back to one, install the newest version again and start it. SMTO can convert data saved by older versions, but it can't read formats it has never seen.
  2. If you didn't change versions, open Technical details and select Copy error details. The message says which part of the saved data uses the format SMTO couldn't read.

What success looks like

  • The startup screen reaches Ready and your conversations appear.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied details and the SMTO version you're running to the person who manages SMTO. Don't edit version numbers in the data files or delete the data folder; that could lose your conversations.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The selected checkpoint's manifest, recovery bundle or logical record version has no compatible migration in this application version, so startup recovery stopped without loading it.

What this means

  • The selected checkpoint uses a logical format or collection layout without a compatible application migration. Automatic recovery never rolls back or replays operations.

Why this can happen

  • The bundle declares a future version or a collection change without an application-owned adapter.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect Server storage diagnostics and retained manifests without changing committed data.

How to fix it

  • Run an application version that includes an explicit migration for the reported checkpoint manifest, recovery bundle or logical record version (RecoveryUnsupported). Preserve the checkpoint; do not edit version numbers or discard fields to force it to load.
  • Use an application version with an explicit migration for the retained format. Preserve the checkpoint; do not edit version numbers or discard fields.

Retry and execution caution

  • A complete supported representation of the selected revision is available.

How to verify the fix

  • The Server validates the paired representations and reaches READY at the selected revision.

What not to do

  • Do not delete evidence, automatically roll back or replay commands.

Technical notes

  • Recovery uses the same committed epoch and revision. No model call participates.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-RST-0017 — SMTO couldn't open your saved data safely
